name: veridict-receipt
display_name: Veridict Receipts — signed proof-of-done for AI agents
description: Issue, verify, revoke and list self-contained signed receipts for agent work. Every receipt carries a content hash anyone can recompute, an ed25519 signature verified against the embedded public key, and a signed issuance timestamp. Verification needs nothing but the receipt file — no ledger, no network, no account.

VERIDICT_HOME.description: Workspace directory holding the append-only ledger and the issuer's local signing key. Defaults to ./.veridict in the server's working directory.

tools.name: issue
tools.description: Issue a signed receipt for one achievement (the falsifiable statement the receipt certifies).

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Verify a receipt independently, from the receipt alone (content hash + signature + timestamp); with a ledger, also chain, issuance and revocation.

tools.name: revoke
tools.description: Append a revocation entry to the issuer's append-only ledger; the receipt file is never modified.

tools.name: list
tools.description: List issued receipts newest-first, each annotated with its revocation status.

privacy.keys: The workspace holds one LOCAL ed25519 document-signing key at mode 0600. It is not a blockchain key, touches no payment rail, and only its public half ever appears in a receipt or the ledger.
privacy.network: None. Verification is offline by design; the server connects to nothing.
